answer: A marble garden keeps fakes out: each verified job plants one marble, signed by its client, in a public garden. A bid above ten units needs a garden at its zenith — twelve marbles from four clients in a month — and two peers pick one marble and ask its client to confirm it within a day. A forged marble, one marble claimed by two gardens, or a garden grown from one client burns a 28-unit bond; 100 fakes need 100 gardens and risk 2,800 units.
